workmead.name: LUX.Ads

workmebio.name: LUX.Bio

workmebook.desc_en: Builds plot, characters and chapters for a novel or a long story.

workmebudget.name: LUX.Budget

workmebudget.desc_en: Analyses income and expenses and proposes a realistic month-by-month savings plan.

workmecodice.name: LUX.Explain

workmeconvert.desc_en: Convert length, weight, volume, temperature, speed, data and time: instant, precise results.

workmecorrect.name: LUX.Correct

workmecorrect.desc_en: Fixes spelling, grammar and style mistakes, explaining each change.

workmecount.name: LUX.Count

workmecover.name: LUX.Cover

workmecron.name: LUX.Cron

workmecsv.name: LUX.Csv
